policy: Every Critical and High finding remained release-blocking until the final independent review proved it Fixed or NotApplicable.

findings.current_tree: The exact AWS-LC 5.5.0 manifest is repository-visible and validated, and the hosted clean-checkout provider build passed.
The final review accepted hosted run 33233671568, exact-candidate run 33237855698, and active strict main ruleset 21787899 with no bypass actors.
Every CJPM phase invokes the combined native builder, and the missing-resolver clean-checkout reproduction completes cjpm check.
M7-021 qualification binds native manifests, C/H sources, build scripts, build.cj, lockfile and manifest; focused mutation tests pass. Final artifact regeneration remains a later release gate.
Active ruleset 21787899 strictly enforces clean-cangjie-build, prohibits deletion and non-fast-forward updates, and has no bypass actors.
The server transfers the reserved DATA permit to the writer; Http2WriteSchedulerTest passed 10 focused cases and the final review accepted the disposition.
RFC peer defaults, local caps and advertised settings are separated and server ENABLE_PUSH is prohibited; Http2SettingsTest passed 9 focused cases and the final review accepted the disposition.
The cancellation wrapper preserves the delegate completion policy; HttpFacadeTest passed 14 focused cases and the final review accepted the disposition.
Apache-2.0 licensing and exact AWS-LC LICENSE and NOTICE are release inputs whose digests are bound by manifest and SPDX tests. Final artifact regeneration remains a later release gate.
Authenticated CONNECT tunnels fail closed to one lease without a stable credential identity; 2 focused proxy cases passed and the final review accepted the disposition.
Close stops admission without joining libc or NSS calls; live pools are capped at 8 and workers at 64. Fault injection proves fail-closed overload and recovery after reaping.
Write timeout is Never retryable when zero physical commit cannot be proven; 19 focused transport cases passed and the final review accepted the disposition.
Accept uses a bounded wait quantum without closing the shared listener; 19 focused transport cases passed including listener reuse.
Bundle and hashed-directory identities bind bounded deterministic SHA-256 content; 5 focused adapter cases passed and the final review accepted the disposition.
